outline: This course aims to give students both a theoretical and a practical foundation in software testing. In the particular, students will learn about software quality assurance concepts, test planning, test analysis and design, test execution, test result analysis, and test documentation. The course will cover the fundamental subjects on software testing, including testing concepts and principles, testing process, testing techniques, test coverage criteria, testing tools, and regression testing. The course will also cover several testing techniques for specific applications, including object-oriented software, web applications, and Android Apps.
